item.description:
Point Translate 0.11.2
Fixes the Sparkle installer connection error by removing a sandbox-only installer launcher setting from this non-sandboxed app.
Versions 0.11.0 and 0.11.1 need one manual replacement: download the disk image, quit Point Translate, and drag the app into Applications. Future in-app updates use the corrected installer configuration.
Ordinary text selection leaves your clipboard alone. Press Command + Option + C to translate and copy deliberately.
